The task: File management app, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). Strings:
- s1: button to create a new container (folder) → in Taiwan UI terms, "新增資料夾" (not 文件夾, not 新建文件夹)
- s2: status text after creation → e.g., "資料夾已建立" or "已建立資料夾"
- s3: dialog title for moving an item → e.g., "移動項目" or "移動到此資料夾". The context: user can move an item into the folder. Dialog title could be "移動項目" or "移動項目至資料夾". Taiwan usage: "移動" or "搬移". Common: "移動項目" fine. Could also be "移至資料夾".

Output JSON only.

s1: "新增資料夾"
s2: "資料夾已建立"
s3: "移動項目"

Maybe s2 could be "已建立「xxx」資料夾" but we don't have variable placeholders. Keep simple: "資料夾已建立"。

s3: moving item into container → "移動項目" is fine; could be "將項目移至資料夾". Dialog title typically "移動項目". I'll use "移動項目".</think>{
  "s1": "新增資料夾",
  "s2": "資料夾已建立",
  "s3": "移動項目"
}
